lines: They come out with the heat, and she doesn't even notice at first.
Claws out, breath short. She laughs it off.
A claw catches. "Ugh. This keeps happening."
She goes glassy, drunk on a smell only she can catch.
Her teeth graze harder than she meant. "Sorry!"
A nip she didn't plan, then a wince.
A bead of venom wells up and falls. She wipes it away, flushed.
She lands badly, catches herself, and swears.
Her legs cross wrong and she stumbles. "Ignore that."
A click escapes her. She tilts her head, listening to the echo.
